verification_vocabulary: Same as GRAPH-FORMAT.md: bibliographic_metadata_checked = identity/edition checked against the record named; supporting_page_checked = an abstract, publisher summary, contents page, review text or opening text was read for the specific point in the note; unverified = could not be confirmed, kept out of proposed sources.
